topic: Someone discovers a hidden room in their new house
text: Oh my gosh, a hidden room? That’s like something out of a mystery novel! Are you sure you’re okay with it? It’s kind of creepy, isn’t it? But also, isn’t it exciting? Think of all the stories that wall could tell. You should be super careful going in there though, just check everything’s safe, you know? Maybe get someone to look it over before you explore it. I can’t even imagine what you might find. It’s thrilling, really, but do keep me updated on everything, okay? I’m right here, just text or call anytime!
